account.label: Account
account.description: An organisation a rep sells to. Private to its rep.
account.title: name

deal.label: Deal
deal.description: One opportunity at an account, scored from its ledger.
deal.title: name

record.label: Record
record.description: One fact in the ledger. Never edited; an undo writes a compensating record.
record.title: summary

stakeholder.label: Stakeholder
stakeholder.description: A person at an account who matters to a deal.
stakeholder.title: name

deal.set_stage.label: Change stage
deal.set_stage.description: Move the deal to another of the company's stages, citing the record that justifies it. Writes a stage record; the stage is recomputed from it.

record.add.label: Add a record
record.add.description: Write one safe fact to the deal's ledger, such as a meeting held or something learned. kind is one of the company's kinds of record.
